name: Pylon
tagline: A web based integrated development environment built with Node. Js as a backend and with a supercharged JavaScript/HTML5 frontend, licensed under GPL version 3. This project originates from Cloud9 v2 project.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/pylon:2.10.0@sha256:5552a0c4b42f1e09a1146d2265c790fb2833128ec3ea9ebf1b0c634d40784e01
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
      GITURL: ''
      PYUSER: ''
      PYPASS: ''
    ports:
      - target: 3131
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/code
        target: /code
